claims.explanation: BMS-345541 selectively inhibits IKKβ (IKBKB), blocking NF-κB activation. Cancer lines with constitutive or inducible NF-κB activity, often driven by mutations in upstream activators (e.g., KRAS, BRAF, EGFR, PIK3CA, MET) or loss of negative regulators (e.g., PTEN, NF1, NF2), are more dependent on this pathway and thus sensitive. Conversely, lines with intact negative regulation or low NF-κB signaling are less affected.
